facts.fact: 塔拉辛抵达伊弗拉利斯家族东门时，日出才过去几个钟头。
facts.anchor: When Talasyn reached the Ivralis clan’s eastern gate, only a few hours had passed since sunrise.

facts.fact: 卡希尔不肯收回龙牙匕首，让塔拉辛留着。
卡希尔说做姨母的欠她二十年的生日礼物。
facts.anchor: “As your aunt, I owed you two decades’ worth of birthday presents, anyway.”

facts.fact: 奥莉尔供出幕后主使是乌尔杜佳。
奥莉尔说那管血清是乌尔杜佳给她的。
facts.anchor: She was the one who gave me the serum.

facts.fact: 塔拉辛甩出一道金色光链，缠住乌尔杜佳的脖子。
facts.anchor: Talasyn’s arm shot out, unleashing a chain of golden light

facts.fact: 乌尔杜佳承认自己快死了。
塔拉辛走出王座厅，把乌尔杜佳一个人留在半明半暗里。
facts.anchor: She walked out of the throne room, and Urduja Silim was left alone in the half-light.
